'''Matt Scherger''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Rochester, Minnesota tournament]] on 3 February 2001 with Unorganized Pile (Coruscant: Imperial Square start), according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1701">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-rochester-mn-2001d1701/ rochester-mn-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 4 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-rochester-mn-2001d1701/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
